summary: On Aug 23 Edson Smith (UCLA) confirmed primality of 2^43,112,609−1, a 12,978,189-digit Mersenne prime that qualifies GIMPS for the EFF $100,000 prize. Two weeks later Hans-Michael Elvenich (Lanxess) found 2^37,156,667−1, an 11,185,272-digit Mersenne prime that does not qualify. GIMPS verified both numbers over several weeks using independent checks and announced them on September 16.
